reason: Anchorlaw is a DeepSeek Harness code-verification toolchain primarily focused on scanning code, reporting defensive-pattern findings, and supporting verification-oriented development workflows.

summaries.zh: Anchorlaw 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的代码验证工具链，可扫描防御性编程模式、生成健康报告，并为 AI 辅助开发提供验证工作流工具。
summaries.en: Anchorlaw is a DeepSeek Harness code-verification toolchain that scans defensive patterns, generates health reports, and supports verification-oriented workflows for AI-assisted development.

capabilities: Scans source code for documented defensive patterns
Generates scan findings and health reports
Exports noise-card and curriculum data for AI context
Installs host-level or project-level skills, tools, and an agent preset
Supports staged agent workflows with delegated scout, worker, and judge roles
